body.name: Certified finite acceptance-subset program
body.construction: For a coverage level \(q\in[0,1]\), the \(\delta\)-net \(\mathcal U_N\), cells \(o\in\mathcal O_h\), probabilities \(p_{io}\), and subset costs \(c_A\), define \(V_{N,h}(q)\) as the linear-program minimum of \(\zeta\) over \(x_{oA}\ge0\): \(\sum_Ax_{oA}=1\), \(\sum_op_{io}\sum_{A\ni i}x_{oA}\ge q\), and \(\sum_op_{io}\sum_Ac_Ax_{oA}\le\zeta\) for every \(i\). Its dual maximizes \(q\sum_i\ell_i+\sum_o\eta_o\) over \(\pi_i,\ell_i\ge0\), \(\sum_i\pi_i=1\), and unrestricted \(\eta_o\), subject to \(\eta_o\le c_A\sum_i\pi_ip_{io}-\sum_{i\in A}\ell_ip_{io}\) for every \((o,A)\).
